card.name: Digits inside ISBN and ISSN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit partway through an ISBN or ISSN number in a reference citation. Weaker hits fall on 'we' or 'our' in academic prose and on middle parts of author surnames.

modes.label: Digits in ISBN/ISSN
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a book or journal catalog number in a citation.
modes.example: Library. Dist. by Listening Library/Books on Tape. 2012. ISBN 978-0-499-<<0>>1463-9. $

modes.label: We/our in papers
modes.description: The word 'we' or 'our' where authors introduce what they will do or propose.
modes.example: As an alternative,<< we>> now propose the use of synthetic biology approaches

card.plain: It lights up on digits inside catalog numbers (ISBN or ISSN) in reference lists, and weakly on 'we' in research writing.
